properties.name: reflow2 is one part of a three-way partnership — human, model, graph — and is shaped toward what the other two do badly, never toward competing with them
properties.statement:
**ANTHONY'S DIRECTION, 2026-09-02**, given after a colleague said a current model could design a small service in a few hours without reflow2 — and he agreed that was true for the case described:

*"reflow2 is really about a partnership between a human (supplies ideas and direction) + LLM (high reasoning and knowledge) + graph (persistent 'memory' and relationships between bits of knowledge). Together these 3 should be synergistic and complimentary — they shouldn't be trying to replace each other or compete with each other (though it seems with AI, that it keeps getting pushed to overcome the others). It won't compete with continually evolving and better models and we shouldn't compete with models."*

**IT IS ORIENTATION, NOT A LIMIT.** His words: *"nothing here should necessarily limit reflow2, but at the same time let's keep this in mind in future design decisions."* That is why `enforced: false` — he stated the rule's power himself, unprompted, and it is a lens for judgement rather than something a build can check.

---

**WHAT EACH PART BRINGS.** His three, with what the 2026-09-02 evidence adds:

· **HUMAN — ideas and direction.** And: AUTHORITY (whose word settles it, dated and attributable), the STAKES, and REFUSAL TO ACCEPT A PLAUSIBLE CONCLUSION. That last one is not decorative — the prose root cause of 2026-09-02 was found only because he declined a conclusion that still carried an untested "what would refute this", and the answer it produced overturned the one before it.

· **LLM — high reasoning and knowledge.** And: fluency, breadth, cross-domain pattern matching. AND ITS MEASURED WEAKNESSES: no continuity across sessions, no reliable self-check, and a failure mode of being MORE confidently wrong rather than incoherent.

· **GRAPH — persistent memory and the relationships between bits of knowledge.** And: checks that do not reason and therefore cannot be talked round; the record of what was REFUTED; provenance; and the ability to tell "nobody looked" from "looked and found nothing".

---

🛑 **THE ANTI-PATTERN HE NAMED IS THE USEFUL HALF: each part being pushed to overcome the others.** All four directions are real and three already have partial answers in this design:

· **LLM absorbing the GRAPH** — the agent keeps its own notes instead of a durable record. Fails because a check the same agent authors and runs shares its blind spots. Every catch on 2026-09-02 came from a session OTHER than the one that erred.
· **LLM absorbing the HUMAN** — the agent decides. `rule:design-intent-moves-only-on-the-owners-word` already refuses this, and refused twice that day.
· **GRAPH absorbing the LLM** — making detectors judge rather than report, over-formalising what is reasoning. `dec:report-dont-judge` already refuses this.
· **HUMAN absorbing the LLM** — doing by hand what reasoning does well. The mirror error, and the cheapest to fall into quietly.

---

⭐ **THE TEST FOR A FUTURE DESIGN DECISION**, which is what makes this usable rather than a slogan:

> **Is this making one part do another part's job?**

If a proposal has reflow2 out-reasoning a model, it will lose and should not be built. If it has reflow2 deciding what the owner should decide, it is the authority failure. If it has the model keeping the memory, it inherits the model's blind spots. **Build where the three MEET — the seams — not where any one of them already wins.**

⚠️ WHAT THIS DOES NOT LICENSE: cutting things a model can do. He was explicit — *"I'm not saying let's cut the things that a model can do."* Scaffolding that a better model needs less of (skills teaching a workflow, gap phrasing, vocabulary routing) is allowed to erode on its own; it does not need removing, and removing it would cost today's users to serve a hypothetical.

⚠️ NOT ESTABLISHED, and it is the honest hole: the partnership framing is asserted, not measured. The one external signal available — what field reports actually praise — is the PROSE, which sits awkwardly across all three parts and is not obviously any of them.
